title: Martian scout ship finds a volatile primordial Earth

tellings.quote: a group of them were sent out in a craft to go scout out a new world that they could possibly develop as a habitation for themselves

plain: Long ago, according to this account, a group of beings from Mars were sent out in a craft "to go scout out a new world that they could possibly develop as a habitation for themselves," and what they found was a young, unsettled, volatile Earth. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, passing on what a man named Joe McMoneagle described. If true, it would put Martian visitors at the very beginning of Earth's story.
